entry.author: TranspowerNZ
entry.summary:
Te Kanapu is Transpower's initiative to create a future grid blueprint for Aotearoa, to support economic growth and the drive for a net zero 2050.

This webinar, held on 5 May 2026, looked at how Transpower built models to estimate the costs of the options for grid investment that will be considered as part of the development of the draft grid blueprint.

You can read about the options for investment being considered at https://static.transpower.co.nz/public/uncontrolled_docs/Transmission%20Expansion%20and%20Upgrade%20Options%20-%20Te%20Kanapu%20Technical%20Approach%20-%20V1.0%20-%20December%202025.pdf?VersionId=RtIUH33pcCDVVZj9aAwfS6IyNMA1PHId
